most_recent_amendments.3153: Enacted Stats. 1992, Ch. 162, Sec. 10 — no subsequent amendments

section_3150.a_appointment: Best-interest trigger; may appoint private counsel; comply with Cal. Rules of Court 5.240, 5.241, 5.242
section_3150.b_continuing_representation: Appearance triggers continuing representation; removal by substitution or for cause

section_3151.a_role_and_duties: Best-interest representation; gather and present admissible evidence; present child's wishes if child desires; interview child; review files/records; further investigation
section_3151.b_party_like_capacity_and_witness_bar: Service + pleading obligations equivalent to a party; witness bar; full advocacy rights
c_enumerated_rights: (4) Right to take any action available to a party
(5) Access to health, educational, and interview records; no waiver of confidentiality
(6) Advance notice and refusal of non-court-ordered exams
(7) Assertion/waiver of privilege on child's behalf
(8) Right to seek independent examination with court approval

section_3152.a_noticed_motion: Counsel may move for release of CPS records with notice to parties and CPS agency
section_3152.b_in_camera_review: Court reviews in camera; determines relevance and scope of release
section_3152.c_confidentiality: Neither review nor release waives confidentiality; counsel non-disclosure obligation

section_3153.a_party_paid: Reasonable compensation; parties pay in proportions court deems just
section_3153.b_county_paid: County pays uncovered portion when both parties financially unable; Judicial Council guidelines

steward_case_relevance_audit.purpose: Map §§ 3150-3153 against the steward's 16-year record to identify (1) every custody or visitation proceeding in which minor's counsel was NOT appointed but the best-interest factors supported appointment; (2) every proceeding in which minor's counsel WAS appointed but the appointment did not function as Chapter 10 contemplates (Track A qualifications deficit; Track B duties deficit; Track C witness-bar violation; Track D records-access abuse); (3) the § 3153 payment path viable for any future appointment motion.

factor_audits.audit_recommendation: Identify the proceedings in which a § 3150 motion could have been filed by the steward on behalf of the child and was not. A § 3150 motion is a forward-looking remedy in any pending custody or visitation proceeding.

Where minor's counsel was appointed and was called to the stand, or where counsel's personal statements to the court functioned as evidence rather than advocacy, the structural bar was violated. Record these as appellate-issue preservation points.

Where the child's confidential records entered the custody record without minor's counsel controlling the privilege gate, the statutory architecture was bypassed. These are objection and motion-to-strike targets.
Any future minor's-counsel appointment in a proceeding with CPS history should file a § 3152 motion as a matter of course; the in-camera procedure is the only lawful access route.
The party's § 3153(b) motion should be filed concurrently with any § 3150 motion in this matter; financial declarations and Judicial Council eligibility guidelines apply.
